title: On the Furstenberg-Katznelson constant for the IP Szemeredi theorem over finite fields
summary: Bergelson et al. observed that Furstenberg's proof of Szemeredi's theorem provides a positive lower bound on the density of arithmetic progressions in sets of positive density in the integers. Namely, for every $δ\in(0,1]$ and every $k\in \mathbb{N}$, there exists a positive constant $c=c(k,δ)>0$ such that $$\{n\in \mathbb{N} : d(E\cap (E-n)\cap\dots\cap (E-(k-1)n))>c(k,δ)\} \neq \emptyset$$ whenever $d(E)\ge δ$.
